tools.description: The tool to call first, and it's free with no account. Lists the phases the model can report, the timeframes and currencies covered, and a short card for each phase explaining what it means and what tends to come next. tools.name: trendvane_phase_resolution_stats
tools.description: Free, and how you read meaning into a phase. For each one it shows what usually happens next, how often a trend keeps running, and how the typical move rewarded you against how far it drew down first. Every figure comes with the number of past cases behind it. It's a behavior model built from years

tools.name: system_get_notifications
tools.description: Read your account messages: support, billing, and account notices. tools.name: system_get_balance
tools.description: Check your prepaid balance before a paid call. Shows the credit you have left to spend, anything on hold, any bonus credit and when it expires, whether the account is paused, the current pricing, and the deposit addresses on your account. It's free. If you run out, paid calls are turned away until y

tools.name: system_get_usage
tools.description: Your history of paid calls, newest first. For each one it shows which tool you used, the coins and timeframes, how much data came back, and what it cost. Free. Page back through older calls with `before`, using the cursor the previous page returned.

tools.name: system_deposit_poll
tools.description: Call this right after you send a stablecoin deposit to have it picked up sooner: it tells the system to check your deposit addresses now. It moves no money and is free. If it comes back with nothing, you don't have a deposit address yet, so add one from the web dashboard.

tools.name: trendvane_get_phase
tools.description: Get the current market phase for one coin, across a timeframe. This is a paid call. Set `kind` to 'boundary' for the reading from the last closed bar, which is settled and won't change, or 'updates' for the live reading still forming inside the current bar. Leave `tf` off, or set it to 'all', for ev

tools.name: trendvane_compose_phases
tools.description: Get phases for several coins and timeframes in one paid call. Set `kind` to 'boundary' for the settled last-closed-bar reading or 'updates' for the still-forming one. The cost scales with how many readings come back, which is your coins times your timeframes.

tools.name: bfxpremium_get_premium
tools.description: Get the Bitfinex cross-exchange premium for BTC: the latest CLOSED daily residual (in basis points) and its regime state (calm, building, or stress). This is a paid call at a flat per-call price. Set `updates` to true to also append the rolling intra-day reading from the last closed sub-daily bucket

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: system_get_notifications · Public sink: system_deposit_poll · Destructive: system_get_balance.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: system_get_notifications · Public sink: system_deposit_poll · Destructive: system_get_balance

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
